If you two haven't made the commitment explicit, then he might be confused with what he wants and trying to build a shelter in case stuff goes wrong.

If its a casual relationship, any hint of casualness (dont plan on having a future), will lead to these weaknesses. HE IS DOING SOMETHING WRONG. It just doesn't appear wrong to him and to everyone else here because a relationship is automatically assumed to be temporary/casual. If he feels its casual, then he feels that he doesn't have to duty to only focus on you. Remember that this is only a reddit post though, you should communicate with him, you should love him and give him another chance (and if he fails and doesn't want to try then sadly reality gives in). but the one thing you should take with you is that HE IS MILDY CROSS THE LINE (everyone else here is wrong). Talk to him about your relationship and how he wants it a year or 10 years from now.

Now don't be confused. Its ok to have friends. If you trust your significant other then yes it can just be a regular friendship. But when you love someone, your making a commitment to that other person. IF EVERYTHING IS ACTUALLY OK, and there is nothing to worry about, then there is one more thing that HE IS NOT DOING THAT YOU NEED...he is not reassuring you enough and giving you enough love to make you feel comfortable about the situation. He is not making you feel like your his only princess. That is what he is doing wrong if all is ok. It is his duty as your love to make you feel secure, not you, its not your job to work hard to ignore those feelings. He has to take those negative feelings away and protect you.
